slow_trace_example.description: Example trace demonstrating how to identify bottleneck

llm.generate.status: slow - indicates LLM timeout or large context

debugging_notes: Total 4200ms matches user complaint of 4.2-second query
Trace shows LLM generation taking 3800ms (90% of time)
Large prompt_tokens (15K) indicates too much context
Solution: Reduce context docs or switch to faster model

missing_context_propagation.description: Threading without context propagation creates orphaned spans
missing_context_propagation.symptom: Two separate traces instead of one connected trace

high_overhead.description: 100% sampling with fine-grained spans adds 10-20% latency
high_overhead.fix: Reduce sampling to 10%, use coarser spans, BatchSpanProcessor

storage_overflow.description: Jaeger storage fills after 30 days without cleanup
storage_overflow.symptom: Jaeger UI queries take 30+ seconds, OOM errors
storage_overflow.fix: Set BADGER_TTL=168h, use Elasticsearch for >10K traces/day

incomplete_instrumentation.description: Missing spans for HTTP client library
incomplete_instrumentation.symptom: Total time (1200ms) > sum of spans (780ms), 420ms missing
incomplete_instrumentation.fix: Install opentelemetry-instrumentation-httpx or add manual spans

development.rationale: Trace everything for debugging, short retention to save disk

staging.rationale: Balance visibility and cost, 1 week for issue investigation

production.rationale: 10% sampling reduces overhead from 15ms to 1.5ms, 30 days for compliance

traffic_24000_per_day.notes: Need Elasticsearch backend, reduce sampling to 20%
